passages.text: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Isaiah speaks for God.
He cares deeply for Zion.
He cares deeply for Jerusalem.
He will not keep silent for Zion’s sake.
He will not keep still for Jerusalem’s sake.
He will continue to speak and act.
He will do this until Zion’s righteousness shines like a bright light.
He will do this until Jerusalem’s salvation burns like a blazing torch.
passages.original: לְמַ֤עַן צִיּוֹן֙ לֹ֣א אֶחֱשֶׁ֔ה וּלְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶשְׁק֑וֹט עַד־ יֵצֵ֤א כַנֹּ֙גַהּ֙ צִדְקָ֔הּ וִישׁוּעָתָ֖הּ כְּלַפִּ֥יד יִבְעָֽר׃

passages.text: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will act for Zion and Jerusalem.
Nations will see your righteousness.
All kings will see your glory.
The LORD will give you a new name.
The LORD Himself will speak this new name.
passages.original: וְרָא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ צִדְקֵ֔ךְ וְכָל־ מְלָכִ֖ים כְּבוֹדֵ֑ךְ וְקֹ֤רָא לָךְ֙ שֵׁ֣ם חָדָ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִקֳּבֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God holds you in His hand.
You will be a crown of glory in His hand.
You will be a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
passages.original: וְהָיִ֛יתְ עֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּיַד־ יְהוָ֑ה וּצְנוֹף מְלוּכָ֖ה בְּכַף־ אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God also speaks about their land.
People once called you Forsaken.
People once called your land Desolate.
They will not call you Forsaken anymore.
They will not call your land Desolate anymore.
People will call you Hephzibah.
Hephzibah means “My delight is in her.”
People will call your land Beulah.
Beulah means “Married.”
The LORD will take delight in you.
The LORD will rejoice over you.
Your land will belong to the LORD like a bride belongs to her husband.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יֵאָמֵר֩ לָ֨ךְ ע֜וֹד עֲזוּבָ֗ה וּלְאַרְצֵךְ֙ לֹא־ יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה כִּ֣י לָ֗ךְ יִקָּרֵא֙ חֶפְצִי־ בָ֔הּ וּלְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ בְּעוּלָ֑ה כִּֽי־ חָפֵ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ תִּבָּעֵֽל׃

passages.text: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to Jerusalem.
God compares His relationship with Jerusalem to marriage.
A young man marries a young woman.
In the same way, your sons will be joined to you.
A bridegroom rejoices over his bride.
In the same way, your God will rejoice over you.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יִבְעַ֤ל בָּחוּר֙ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יִבְעָל֖וּךְ בָּנָ֑יִךְ וּמְשׂ֤וֹשׂ חָתָן֙ עַל־ כַּלָּ֔ה יָשִׂ֥ישׂ עָלַ֖יִךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves, nor give Him any rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God says, “I have placed watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem.
These watchmen stand guard all day and all night.
They never keep silent.
They always stay alert.
You who remind the LORD, do not be silent.
Do not give yourselves any rest.
Do not give God any rest.
Keep calling to Him until He establishes Jerusalem.
Keep praying until He makes Jerusalem a praise in all the earth.”
passages.original: עַל־ חוֹמֹתַ֣יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הִפְקַ֙דְתִּי֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים כָּל־ הַיּ֧וֹם וְכָל־ הַלַּ֛יְלָה תָּמִ֖יד לֹ֣א יֶחֱשׁ֑וּ הַמַּזְכִּרִים֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה אַל־ דֳּמִ֖י לָכֶֽם׃ וְאַֽל־ תִּתְּנ֥וּ דֳמִ֖י ל֑וֹ עַד־ יְכוֹנֵ֞ן וְעַד־ יָשִׂ֧ים אֶת־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֛ם תְּהִלָּ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has great power.
The LORD has sworn an oath.
He swore by His right hand.
He swore by His strong arm.
He said, “I will not give your grain to your enemies again.
Your enemies will not eat your food.
Foreigners will not drink your new wine.
You worked hard for your grain and your wine.
I will not let others take what you have earned.”
passages.original: נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה בִּֽימִינ֖וֹ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ עֻזּ֑וֹ אִם־ אֶתֵּן֩ אֶת־ דְּגָנֵ֨ךְ ע֤וֹד מַֽאֲכָל֙ לְאֹ֣יְבַ֔יִךְ וְאִם־ יִשְׁתּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ נֵכָר֙ תִּֽירוֹשֵׁ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.”
passages.sermon:
Those who harvest the grain will eat it.
They will praise the LORD.
Those who gather the grapes will drink the wine.
They will drink it in My holy courts.
The LORD promises this blessing to His people.
passages.original: כִּ֤י מְאַסְפָיו֙ יֹאכְלֻ֔הוּ וְהִֽלְל֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמְקַבְּצָ֥יו יִשְׁתֻּ֖הוּ בְּחַצְר֥וֹת קָדְשִֽׁי׃ס

passages.text: Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build it up, build up the highway; clear away the stones; raise a banner for the nations!
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
He commands them to act.
Go out through the gates.
Go out now.
Prepare a way for the people.
Build up the highway.
Make the road ready.
Remove every stone from the path.
Lift up a banner for all the nations.
passages.original: עִבְר֤וּ עִבְרוּ֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֔ים פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָעָ֑ם סֹ֣לּוּ סֹ֤לּוּ הַֽמְסִלָּה֙ סַקְּל֣וּ מֵאֶ֔בֶן הָרִ֥ימוּ נֵ֖ס עַל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to all the earth.
He gives a message for everyone to hear.
He says, “Tell Daughter Zion this message.
Your Savior is coming.
He brings His reward with Him.
His recompense goes before Him.”
passages.original: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה הִשְׁמִ֙יעַ֙ אֶל־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אִמְרוּ֙ לְבַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן הִנֵּ֥ה יִשְׁעֵ֖ךְ בָּ֑א הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He gives them new names.
People will call them “The Holy People.”
They belong to God.
God has saved them.
People will call them “The Redeemed of the LORD.”
God has chosen them.
People will call the city “Sought Out.”
People will call the city “A City Not Forsaken.”
God has not abandoned them.
God is with them.
passages.original: וְקָרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַם־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלָךְ֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א דְרוּשָׁ֔ה עִ֖יר לֹ֥א נֶעֱזָֽבָה׃ס
